pages.text:
Ohakune Accommodation | Canoe Safaris New Zealand Ohakune Accommodation
Nestled at the foot of Mount Ruapehu, our Ohakune accommodation offers a relaxing retreat in the heart of the North Island's adventure capital. Located at 6 Tay Street, Canoe Safaris lodge provides a welcoming and well-equipped stay, whether you're winding down after a Whanganui River Canoe Journey or preparing for a day on the slopes. Unwind in our new hot spring spa pool, the perfect way to ease tired muscles and soak in the mountain air.
Our lodge is more than just a place to sleep—it’s a gateway to Ohakune’s many outdoor experiences . With easy access to Tongariro National Park, Turoa & Whakapapa Ski Fields, and the Whanganui River, it’s an ideal base for year-round adventure. Enjoy the warm, friendly atmosphere and make the most of everything the region has to offer.

For larger families/groups two units can be combined by opening a door between them.
Bookings
To add a stay at our lodge to your Whanganui River trip booking, simply select the accommodation option when reserving your canoe tour online. If your preferred dates appear sold out, give us a call—we may have additional availability at our overflow motel, just a short walk away.
During the winter ski season, our lodge is open for bookings with a weekend surcharge. A minimum two-night stay applies for weekends (Friday–Saturday) and school holidays to accommodate peak demand.
Convenient Location in Ohakune
Our lodge is centrally located at the corner of Tay and Rata Streets, just off Goldfinch Street. Tay Street is the second left when heading toward Mount Ruapehu from Ohakune’s town centre, placing you close to local dining , shopping and outdoor attractions.
For booking inquiries or more details, contact us at [email protected] or call 0800 272 335.
Why Stay at Our Ohakune Lodge?
After a day of exploring the Ruapehu region’s stunning landscapes, you’ll want a place to relax and recharge. Offering more than just a bed, our lodge is a comfortable and convenient retreat best for outdoor enthusiasts.
Prime Location: A short drive from Turoa Ski Field, Tongariro National Park, and the start of your Whanganui River adventure
Relaxing Atmosphere: Comfortable, well-equipped rooms and a spa pool to help you unwind after an active day
Flexible Booking Options: Accommodation available for both summer canoe trips and winter ski stays, with overflow lodging in peak times

pages.text:
About Our Whanganui River Canoe Tours Scroll
About Canoe Safaris - 40+ Years of River Adventures
Founded in 1979, Canoe Safaris has been guiding unforgettable canoe adventures on the Whanganui and Rangitīkei Rivers for over 40 years. With thousands of happy customers and consistent 5-star reviews, we're proud to offer river journeys that combine fun, safety, and the magic of New Zealand's wilderness. Whether you're new to paddling or an experienced adventurer, our guided tours strike the perfect balance of relaxation, challenge, discovery, and excitement.
Our History
Since our first trip more than four decades ago, Canoe Safaris has been committed to sharing the beauty of New Zealand’s North Island rivers with locals, and travellers from around the globe. We’ve grown from a small family business into one of the country’s most trusted canoe guiding companies while holding onto our personal touch and small-business values. Our goal has always remained the same - to ensure guests of all ages, interests & abilities make the most of this once-in-a-lifetime experience.
Thousands of adventurers — from families with young children to explorers in their eighties — have joined us to Canoe the Whanganui River and Paddle the Rangitīkei River along with rafting the Mohaka, many leaving with lifelong memories and new friendships. Our reputation for safe, well-organised, and welcoming trips has been built on the dedication of our guides and the joy of our guests.
Our Guides
The Canoe Safaris guiding team is the heart of what we do . Company owner Phillip Collins has been guiding trips on the Whanganui River since 2012 and has worked on rivers all over the world. Every member of our team is highly trained and are experts in river safety, first aid, and rescue, while also bringing the journey to life with stories about local history, wildlife, and Māori heritage.
At the end of a day paddling, our guides transform into camp chefs — serving hearty, three-course meals that often surprise guests with just how good wilderness dining can be. And yes, a bottle of New Zealand wine is always close at hand.
Our Food
We’ve built a reputation for having some of the best food on the river . Forget the usual camp meals — think hot cooked breakfasts, fresh lunches, plentiful snacks and gourmet three-course dinners enjoyed under the stars by the riverside. Our trips prove that eating well is just as important as paddling well.
Our Gear
Comfort and safety come first. We upgrade gear every season and provide high-quality equipment including spacious Genuine imported Canadian canoes, waterproof barrels, roomy tents, thick mattresses, and all the camping essentials. Everything is chosen for durability, comfort, and keeping you dry — so you can focus on the adventure.
Our Commitment to the Environment
We operate under approved concessions with the Department of Conservation (DoC) for Whanganui National Park and Kaweka Forest Park, and we’re proud members of the New Zealand Rafting Association . Our guides also hold canoe and rafting qualifications with the New Zealand Outdoor Instructors Association (NZOIA) .
On every trip we practice Leave No Trace principles: asking guests to use eco-friendly toiletries, pack out all rubbish, and avoid single-use plastics. Together, we can help protect the river for future generations.
So, Why Choose Canoe Safaris for your Whanganui River Canoe Trip?

pages.text:
FAQ's | Canoe Safaris New Zealand FAQs
Planning your Rangitikei Or Whanganui River Canoe Trip and have some questions? We've got you covered!
How do we get to and from the river? Where do we leave our vehicle?
We'll take care of your transportation needs. Canoe Safaris offers a shuttle service to and from the Whanganui River from our Ohakune base - this shuttle is included in the cost of your tour. You can safely leave your vehicle in our private off-street car park while you're away. We also have a secure office for storing small valuables that you don't want to leave in your car or take on the river.
Will I capsize?
While capsizing on the Whanganui River is a possibility, don't worry – our expert guides are always on hand to help. With their friendly guidance and extensive canoeing knowledge, you'll learn how to navigate the river and improve your canoeing skills to minimise the risk of tipping out.
That being said, even with the best preparation, unexpected moments can happen. A slight loss of balance, a rapid, or even a premature celebration can send you into the water. But remember, you'll be wearing a life jacket at all times, so the key is to stay calm. Listen to your guide's clear instructions, and they'll have you back in your canoe in no time, laughing off the experience.
What about pre and post trip accommodation?
For a hassle-free experience, consider staying at our onsite Canoe Safaris Lodge , conveniently located in the heart of Ohakune. Consider arriving the day before your trip to get settled, and take advantage of our private off-street parking and hot tub facilities.
Our lodge rooms are perfect for families or small groups, with an ensuite, kitchenette, and comfortable bedding (Queen, Single and optional pull-out sofabed) for up to four, or five people.
After your Whanganui River adventure, and for a fully relaxing getaway - why not treat yourself? Stay and unwind in our comfortable surroundings, head into town and en joy a well deserved meal at one of Ohakune's many eateries. Read our Guide to Ohakune's restaurants.
Ohakune can be a great base to tick off some other local, fun activities - For an action packed getaway, after your canoe trip, hire a bike and test yourself on one of the many Ohakune bike trails,
How will we be prepared for the river journey?
Your experienced river guide will provide a clear and comprehensive paddle and safety briefing at the river's edge before you set off. Throughout your journey, they'll share expert tips and techniques to help you navigate the river with confidence, improve your canoeing skills, and minimise the risk of tip-outs.
Upon booking and In the build up to your departure, you will also receive helpful pre trip information and tips to help you with your planning and preparation, the Canoe Safaris Team are available on the phone or email to answer any questions before you arrive.
How many days are right for my trip?
Consider what you want to achieve on your Whanganui River adventure. Are you seeking an action-packed, fast-paced experience suited to our 3 Day Canoe Tour? Or a relaxed journey with time to hone your canoeing skills and explore hidden gems on our 4 Day Whanganui River Guided Tour ? Or do you want to fully immerse yourself in the wilderness on our 5-Day Whanganui Canoe Trip?
To help you decide, we recommend exploring the Whanganui River map to familiarise yourself with the area. While the journey may take you out of your comfort zone, trust us – the stunning scenery and unforgettable experiences will make every kilometre worthwhile!
Where do i stay on my river tour?
Along the Whanganui River Journey you will find many Department of Conservation river campsites , including Ohinepane, Ohauora, Mangapurua, Whakahoro, John Coull, and more. These sites provide the basic cooking and bathroom amenities you would need and are evenly spaced out to maximise your camping experience.
There are a few options for alternative accommodations such as hut and cabin upgrades depending on tour length and group size.
How long is the Whanganui River Journey?
The full Whanganui River Journey spans 120km -145km over 5 days, from Taumaranui to Pipiriki. Alternatively, You can opt for a shorter 3 or 4 day adventure, paddling 90km from Whakahoro to Pipiriki through the breathtaking Whanganui National Park.
How hard is the Whanganui River Canoe Journey? Do i have to be very fit?
Our Whanganui River Canoe tours cater to a wide age range, from 6 years old to 82+! While a basic level of fitness and a positive attitude are essential, we tailor our trips to suit each customer's needs. Whether you're a young backpacker, a family with young children, or an active retiree, we have options to suit your fitness level and preferences.
If you have physical limitations or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out. We've helped many people with disabilities complete the journey, and we're committed to making it accessible to everyone. Our expert guides will work with you to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience. Contact us to discuss your specific needs and concerns – we're here to help!
What grade rapids are on the Whanganui River?
The Whanganui River rapids are classified as Grade 1 and 2, making it an ideal destination for beginners. With the New Zealand River Grading system topping out at Grade 6, our rapids are characterized as 'moving water with small, unchallenging waves' or 'easily seen rapids with wide channels and minimal navigation required'. Your expert guide will instruct you on navigating these rapids, ensuring a fun and safe experience.
Is the Whanganui River one of New Zealand's Great Walk?
The Whanganui River journey is indeed one of New Zealand's 10 Great Walks , but with a unique twist - you get to explore it by canoe or kayak! This 3-5 day adventure takes you through stunning green gorges, exciting rapids, and a rich cultural heritage within the Whanganui National Park .

Plan Your Whanganui River Journey | Unguided & Guided Canoe Trips Scroll
Plan your Whanganui River Adventure
Every great Whanganui River trip begins with a little planning. From choosing between Unguided Freedom hire or an All Inclusive Guided Canoe Tour, planning when to book and where to stay, knowing what to pack and how to get here - A smooth start and clear plan means you are making the most of this once-in-a-lifetime experience.
The following pages will guide you through every step, helping you enjoy a safe, fun and unforgettable River Journey.
Canoe Safaris has a trip to suit everyone, offering a chance to see the North Island like never before, Whether you're :
A solo traveller
A family with young children
A Young -at- heart explorer
An adrenaline seeking couple
Someone looking to tick off the famous Whanganui River Journey as part of the New Zealand Great Walks system
..We have a tour and a schedule that will ensure you are getting exactly what you want from your time on the river - enjoying every breathtaking scene. These iconic waterways can get busy, so planning and booking ahead is essential.
Why Plan Ahead?
Secure limited campsite & hut bookings - Especially during Long weekends, School Holidays & Peak periods.
Choose the right trip for you - Whanganui River Guided Tour , Unguided Freedom hire OR a Rangitikei River Canoe Adventure ?
Maximise your time on the river - Four Day Guided Tours and Five Day Guided Whanganui River trips will allow you more flexibility and for campsites, more time to relax and explore.
Safe & stress free Journey with the right gear and preparation.
